summary: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement dated October 16, 2026 for its CFC InterNotes program, an ordinary medium-term note shelf takedown mechanism. Notes may be offered from time to time with specific terms set in a separate pricing supplement covering price, interest rate and maturity; CFC receives 99.7% to 96.85% of gross proceeds after agent discounts of 0.3% to 3.15%. InspereX leads with Citigroup, RBC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo Advisors as agents. No exchange listing is planned. This is routine debt issuance, not a special situation; watch only funding conditions and spread pricing.
